svg.title: Medskill Panda workflow
svg.desc: Your materials go to the orchestrator, which interviews you, measures your template and writes a plan you approve. Fresh subagents then gather evidence, make figures, build the deck and audit it, with a fix loop of up to three rounds, before the deck is delivered. Every stage writes a file to the talk folder.
svg.text: each slide, the claims it needs,
a fresh context for each stage · they work from files, not from the chat
two independent reviewers, run in parallel
notes on how a figure was made
otherwise the finding goes back to its stage
full text, and what was not
